notes: Patterns are unique in .text of the build above. 'expect' is the value for that build (an RVA for globals/functions/vtables, a byte offset for structure members and vtable slots).

entries.name: GEngine
entries.desc: UEngine* GEngine (the UGameEngine instance).
entries.howto: String L"CALIBRATEMOTION" -> its only code reference -> the mov rcx,[rip+x] just before it.

entries.name: GMalloc
entries.desc: FMalloc* GMalloc. Every engine allocation goes through its vtable (+0x10 Malloc, +0x18 Realloc, +0x20 Free). Lazily created by the function called when it is null.
entries.howto: Any `mov rcx,[GMalloc]; test rcx,rcx; jne; call CreateGMalloc` sequence, e.g. in the FFakeStereoRendering destructor.

entries.name: IConsoleManager::Singleton
entries.desc: IConsoleManager* singleton (FConsoleManager). Null until IConsoleManager::SetupSingleton runs (the call that follows).
entries.howto: Inside any static TAutoConsoleVariable registration, e.g. the one for L"r.StereoEmulationFOV".

entries.name: IConsoleManager::SetupSingleton
entries.desc: Creates the console manager if it does not exist yet.

entries.name: UEngine::StereoRenderingDevice
entries.desc: Offset of TSharedPtr<IStereoRendering, ESPMode::ThreadSafe> StereoRenderingDevice in UEngine: object pointer here, reference controller at +8. Read from the last statement of UEngine::InitializeHMDDevice (return StereoRenderingDevice.IsValid()).

entries.name: UEngine::XRSystem
entries.desc: Offset of TSharedPtr<IXRTrackingSystem, ESPMode::ThreadSafe> XRSystem in UEngine. Read from InitializeHMDDevice: `else if (!XRSystem.IsValid() && !FParse::Param(cmdline, L"nohmd"))`.

entries.name: UEngine::ViewExtensions
entries.desc: Offset of TSharedPtr<FSceneViewExtensions> ViewExtensions in UEngine. Read from ULocalPlayer::GetProjectionData (GEngine->ViewExtensions->GatherActiveExtensions()).

entries.name: UEngine::GameViewport
entries.desc: Offset of UGameViewportClient* GameViewport in UEngine. Read from UGameEngine::Init (GameViewport = ViewportClient right after the client is created).

entries.name: UEngine::InitializeHMDDevice
entries.desc: bool UEngine::InitializeHMDDevice(). Virtual, UGameEngine vtable slot 111 (+0x378). Honours -emulatestereo and r.EnableStereoEmulation (creates FFakeStereoRendering), else asks the HMD modules. Called once from UEngine::Init before the game viewport and local player are created.
entries.howto: String L"emulatestereo" -> its code reference -> containing function. Its first instruction block also references L"r.EnableStereoEmulation".

entries.name: UEngine::Init
entries.desc: void UEngine::Init(IEngineLoop*). UEngine vtable slot 74. Calls InitializeHMDDevice through the vtable.
entries.howto: The only function that calls [vtable+0x378] on `this` among the engine vtables; called from UGameEngine::Init.

entries.name: UEngine::IsStereoscopic3D
entries.desc: bool UEngine::IsStereoscopic3D(FViewport* InViewport): (!InViewport || InViewport->IsStereoRenderingAllowed()) && StereoRenderingDevice && StereoRenderingDevice->IsStereoEnabled(). Reads GEngine, not this.

entries.name: UGameEngine::vftable
entries.desc: UGameEngine vtable. Tick is slot 78, Init slot 74, InitializeHMDDevice slot 111.

entries.name: UGameEngine::Tick
entries.desc: void UGameEngine::Tick(float DeltaSeconds, bool bIdleMode). UGameEngine vtable slot 78. Game thread, once per frame.

entries.name: UGameEngine::Init
entries.desc: void UGameEngine::Init(IEngineLoop*). Calls UEngine::Init, then creates the UGameViewportClient, the game viewport and the first local player.

entries.name: FFakeStereoRendering::vftable
entries.desc: vtable of the engine's own FFakeStereoRendering (15 slots: 14 IStereoRendering virtuals + virtual destructor). Gives the IStereoRendering layout of this build.
entries.howto: Constructor = the function referencing L"r.StereoEmulationHeight"; its first lea rax,[rip+x] is the vtable.

entries.name: FFakeStereoRendering::FFakeStereoRendering
entries.desc: FFakeStereoRendering constructor (this, no other arguments). Sets FOV=100, Width=640, Height=480, then applies r.StereoEmulationFOV/Width/Height. Object size 0x18.

entries.name: FFakeStereoRendering::SharedRefController::vftable
entries.desc: vtable of the TSharedPtr reference controller InitializeHMDDevice allocates for the fake device (slot 0 DestroyObject -> device vtable +0x70, slot 1 scalar deleting destructor).

entries.name: FSceneViewport::FViewport::vftable
entries.desc: vtable of the FViewport subobject of FSceneViewport (FSceneViewport+8; UGameViewportClient::Viewport points here). 51 slots. [1] GetRenderTargetTexture, [3] GetSizeXY, [34] GetDebugCanvas, [37] EnqueueBeginRenderFrame, [48] IsStereoRenderingAllowed, [49] GetRenderTargetTextureSizeXY, [50] UpdateViewportRHI.

entries.name: FSceneViewport::EnqueueBeginRenderFrame
entries.desc: void FSceneViewport::EnqueueBeginRenderFrame(bool bShouldPresent). Game thread. Asks the render target manager ShouldUseSeparateRenderTarget / NeedReAllocateViewportRenderTarget, sets bForceSeparateRenderTarget and calls UpdateViewportRHI when needed, and at the end calls IStereoRenderTargetManager::UpdateViewport.

entries.name: FSceneViewport::InitDynamicRHI
entries.desc: void FSceneViewport::InitDynamicRHI() (FRenderResource subobject, this = FViewport+0x10). Render thread. Sizes the separate render target with CalculateRenderTargetSize and allocates it with AllocateRenderTargetTexture, falling back to RHICreateTargetableShaderResource2D.

entries.name: RHICreateTargetableShaderResource2D
entries.desc: RHICreateTargetableShaderResource2D(SizeX, SizeY, Format, NumMips, Flags, TargetableFlags, bForceSeparate, CreateInfo, OutTargetable, OutShaderResource, NumSamples). Used by InitDynamicRHI when the stereo device does not allocate the target.

entries.name: UGameViewportClient::Draw
entries.desc: void UGameViewportClient::Draw(FViewport*, FCanvas*). Game thread. Builds the view family; in stereo it asks every local player for 2 views (3 with the monoscopic far field) through ULocalPlayer::CalcSceneView with pass 1, 2 (3).

entries.name: FSlateRHIRenderer::DrawWindow_RenderThread
entries.desc: Slate window draw on the render thread. Calls StereoRenderingDevice->RenderTexture_RenderThread(RHICmdList, BackBuffer, ViewportRT, WindowSize) when a stereo device is set and the viewport has a separate render target.

entries.name: ULocalPlayer::GetProjectionData
entries.desc: bool ULocalPlayer::GetProjectionData(FViewport*, EStereoscopicPass, FSceneViewProjectionData&) const. ULocalPlayer vtable slot 82. Calls AdjustViewRect, CalculateStereoViewOffset (with WorldSettings->WorldToMeters) and GetStereoProjectionMatrix on the stereo device.

entries.name: ULocalPlayer::CalcSceneView
entries.desc: FSceneView* ULocalPlayer::CalcSceneView(...). ULocalPlayer vtable slot 73 (+0x248).

entries.name: ULocalPlayer::GetViewPoint
entries.desc: void ULocalPlayer::GetViewPoint(FMinimalViewInfo&, EStereoscopicPass). ULocalPlayer vtable slot 72 (+0x240).

entries.name: ULocalPlayer::PostInitProperties
entries.desc: ULocalPlayer::PostInitProperties: ViewState.Allocate(); if (GEngine->StereoRenderingDevice) { StereoViewState.Allocate(); MonoViewState.Allocate(); }. ULocalPlayer vtable slot 9.

entries.name: FSceneViewStateReference::Allocate
entries.desc: void FSceneViewStateReference::Allocate(). Game thread.

entries.name: ULocalPlayer::vftable
entries.desc: ULocalPlayer vtable (no SE subclass seen at runtime yet).

entries.name: GUObjectArray
entries.desc: FUObjectArray GUObjectArray. Not chunked: ObjObjects.Objects (FUObjectItem*, 0x18 bytes per item) at +0x10, MaxElements +0x18, NumElements +0x1C. The anchor reads GUObjectArray+0x10.

entries.name: FNamePool
entries.desc: Static FNamePool object (newer name-pool layout backported into this engine): entry blocks at +0x10, entry = Blocks[id >> 16] + 2 * (id & 0xFFFF); entry header is a uint16 with Len = header >> 6, bIsWide = header & 1. Lazily constructed behind a bool guard.

entries.name: FName::ToString
entries.desc: void FName::ToString(FString& Out) const. About 1000 callers.

entries.name: GSystemResolution
entries.desc: FSystemResolution GSystemResolution {int32 ResX, ResY; EWindowMode WindowMode; ...}. Found by the only `cmp dword ptr [rip+x], 1920` in .text (method of the community UEVR plugin).

entries.name: r.EnableStereoEmulation data
entries.desc: TConsoleVariableData<int32>* of the static r.EnableStereoEmulation cvar (game-thread value at +0). Registered the first time InitializeHMDDevice runs.

entries.name: FConsoleManager::vftable
entries.desc: FConsoleManager vtable (object created by IConsoleManager::SetupSingleton, size 0xB8). Slot 18 (+0x90) FindConsoleVariable(const TCHAR*), slot 19 (+0x98) FindConsoleObject(const TCHAR*), slot 7 (+0x38) CallAllConsoleVariableSinks.

entries.name: FDeferredShadingSceneRenderer::RenderLights
entries.desc: Renderer: builds the sorted light list and renders lights. Found from L"ScreenShadowMaskTexture".

entries.name: RenderLights light sort-key patch site
entries.desc: `mov esi, 0x40` (BE 40 00 00 00) that sets SE's sort-key bit 0x40. The community fix writes 0x60 to the immediate (byte at +1) so these lights also get bit 0x20. Fixes lights rendering wrong (green) at non-16:9 view aspect ratios, which includes every VR eye view.

entries.name: FPostProcessSettings::FPostProcessSettings
entries.desc: Default constructor of FPostProcessSettings. The vignette mod hooks its epilogue to override VignetteIntensity.

entries.name: FSceneViewport::bForceSeparateRenderTarget
entries.desc: Offset of bForceSeparateRenderTarget relative to the FViewport subobject (UGameViewportClient::Viewport). bUseSeparateRenderTarget is the byte before it. From FSceneViewport::EnqueueBeginRenderFrame.

entries.name: UGameViewportClient::Viewport
entries.desc: Offset of FViewport* Viewport in UGameViewportClient. From ULocalPlayer::GetProjectionData (mono branch).

entries.name: FSceneView::StereoPass
